title: A hands-on OMOP CDM workshop in R
description:
A hands-on workshop in which participants explore a synthetic OMOP Common Data Model dataset (synthea-covid19-10k) in R, with CDMConnector, PatientProfiles and OmopSketch, through a learnr tutorial in their browser. A facilitator opens the parts of the workshop and releases feedback live.

Everything runs in containers: one tutorial per participant (ShinyProxy), a plumber api with the state and the answer key, a Shiny facilitator app and Caddy for HTTPS.
